fts_only.candidate_set: pooled union over a capture's derived queries (max_queries=15); the per-query window is `k` candidates per mention

prior_off.definition: no prior: every mention mints (not measured)

entity_rerank.graph_terms_on_this_population: INERT BY CONSTRUCTION: the eval graph holds one :Object per name and no claims, so every row answers degree 0 / confidence null — read `signals_informative` rather than assuming the graph moved anything
entity_rerank.identity_dimension: exact normalised-name equality (entity_resolver's fold) sorts ahead of the score for entity rows only

pooled_budget_note: a pooled group is `max_queries` (15) names, which is the production BUDGET CAP, not the typical capture — a capture with 5 entities issues 5 object queries
